requirements.text: Parallel CodeWiki write roles default to isolated Git worktrees/branches per task and role, with an explicit solo-mode override only when safe.
A worktree factory/orchestrator prepares, records, heartbeats, verifies, and cleans builder, validator, and publisher worktrees with branch/path/base/head/tree/clean/digest metadata.

Task-close and publication use a publisher/merge queue: builders produce branch or patch refs, validators verify immutable refs from fresh worktrees, and publishers serialize final merge/commit/generated-state updates with clean proof.
Artifact wait/wake records name exact branch, patch, claim, and next safe action so sessions do not block solely on unrelated shared worktree dirtiness.

Once the isolated worktree/publisher path lands, /wiki-session-handoff compatibility cleanup should remove or extract the shim in a dedicated worktree unless an explicit migration task requires preservation.
